seed_rule: world j uses world_seed_base+j and bootstrap_seed_base+j, j=0..63; PCG64
decision_rule: No tuning, seed search, selection, exclusion of bad worlds, or statistical early stopping. Stage 8 assesses budget only. Stage 64 uses the same frozen law and seeds. Abort retains completed and current-world evidence.

resource_only_pilot_gate.measured_pilot_elapsed: t8: externally timed complete invocation elapsed seconds, including imports/startup and final output writes; parent retains wrapper receipt. Internal manifest elapsed begins after imports and is diagnostic only.
resource_only_pilot_gate.projected_full_elapsed: 8 * t8; conservatively includes startup eight times
resource_only_pilot_gate.full_stage_admission: Parent explicit admission required after actual pilot resource audit. Passing resource gate alone does not authorize stage64. All64 seeds, law, and metrics remain unchanged.

beta_intercept_definition: log(0.08), fixed once before any registered world is generated
